docstring: Evaluates sliding window log rate limiter, evicts expired timestamps, and appends current_time if allowed.
signature: def check_sliding_window_rate_limit(timestamps: list[float], current_time: float, limit: int, window_seconds: float) -> tuple[bool, list[float]]:
ref_test:
def test_sliding_window():
    allowed, ts = check_sliding_window_rate_limit([], 10.0, 2, 5.0)
    assert allowed is True
    assert ts == [10.0]

    allowed, ts = check_sliding_window_rate_limit(ts, 12.0, 2, 5.0)
    assert allowed is True
    assert ts == [10.0, 12.0]

    # Rejection at limit
    allowed, ts = check_sliding_window_rate_limit(ts, 13.0, 2, 5.0)
    assert allowed is False
    assert ts == [10.0, 12.0]

    # After window expiration (10.0 drops off at 15.1)
    allowed, ts = check_sliding_window_rate_limit(ts, 15.5, 2, 5.0)
    assert allowed is True
    assert ts == [12.0, 15.5]

    raised = False
    try:
        check_sliding_window_rate_limit([], 1.0, 0, 5.0)
    except ValueError:
        raised = True
    assert raised
